name: h
description: AI coding agent — 27 tools, 11 sub-agent types, DeepSeek-powered, ~6x less memory than VS Code

scripts.desktop:dev: set ELECTRON_DEV=1&& concurrently "cd client && npx vite --config vite.config.ts" "npm run desktop:start-electron"
scripts.desktop:build-server: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('server','bootstrap-packaged.cjs'); const outDir=path.resolve('dist','server'); if(!fs.existsSync(outDir))fs.mkdirSync(outDir,{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join(outDir,'bootstrap-packaged.cjs')); console.log('[build-server] Copied bootstrap-packaged.cjs to dist/server/');"
scripts.dist:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const d=path.resolve('dist'); if(!fs.existsSync(d))process.exit(0); for(const name of fs.readdirSync(d)){ const p=path.join(d,name); try { const st=fs.lstatSync(p); if(st.isDirectory()&&/^(win|nsis|mac|linux)-/i.test(name)) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true}); else if(/\.(exe|msi|dmg|pkg|AppImage|deb|rpm|zip|tar\.gz|blockmap|yml|yaml|json|sha256|sig)$/i.test(name)) fs.rmSync(p,{force:true}); } catch(e){} }"
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run dist:clean && npm run icon:generate && npm run desktop:build-server && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/embed-icon.js && electron-builder --win --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['electron-rebuild','--only','node-pty'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (r.status !== 0) { console.warn('node-pty rebuild failed; terminal will fall back to pipe mode.'); } } catch(e) { console.warn('electron-rebuild skipped; terminal will fall back to pipe mode.'); }" && node scripts/patch-electron-name.js
